A '''unidentified young trainee''' lived on [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] and was a member of the [[Legislative Youth Program/Legends|Legislative Youth Program]]. In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the trainee was a passenger on the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Jafan III]]'' and compared notes with [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] about their experience on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].
